bigquery_transfer.custom_report_gaql: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.advertising_channel_type, segments.date, segments.hour, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions FROM campaign
bigquery_transfer.custom_report_note: No WHERE, ORDER BY or LIMIT in a transfer report; segments.date is kept so it can be backfilled. Filter and sort in the SQL that reads it.
bigquery_transfer.sql_on_standard_tables:
SELECT s.segments_hour AS hour,
       ROUND(SUM(s.metrics_cost_micros) / 1e6, 2) AS cost,
       SUM(s.metrics_clicks) AS clicks,
       SUM(s.metrics_conversions) AS conversions,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(s.metrics_cost_micros) / 1e6, SUM(s.metrics_conversions)), 2) AS cost_per_lead
FROM `<project>.<dataset>.ads_HourlyCampaignStats_1234567890` s
JOIN `<project>.<dataset>.ads_Campaign_1234567890` c
  ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id AND c._DATA_DATE = c._LATEST_DATE
WHERE s._DATA_DATE BETWEEN '2026-07-23' AND '2026-10-20'
  AND c.campaign_advertising_channel_type = 'SEARCH'
  AND LOWER(c.campaign_name) NOT LIKE '%brand%'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour
